During the drive the rover stopped several times to make measurements with its Dynamic Albedo of Neutrons instrument (DAN)

DAN is an active/passive neutron spectrometer that measures the abundance and depth distribution of H- and OH-bearing materials (e.g., adsorbed water, hydrated minerals) in a shallow layer (~1 m) of Mars' subsurface along the path of the MSL rover.
